raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43988.

With a compressed-tensors NVFP4 W4A4 checkpoint on SM100, `--fp4-gemm-backend marlin` crashes during CUDA-graph capture:

```
flashinfer.utils.BackendSupportedError: mm_fp4 does not support backend 'marlin' with capability 100
```

`_get_scheme_from_parts` returns the native `CompressedTensorsW4A4Fp4` linear whenever the capability check passes. That scheme hands the backend name straight to FlashInfer `mm_fp4`, which has no `marlin` backend. FP4 Marlin is weight-only, and #40022 already added the weight-only path (`CompressedTensorsW4A16Fp4(has_input_global_scale=True)`) for W4A4 checkpoints, but it is only taken when the capability check fails.

## Modifications

- `compressed_tensors.py`: when `--fp4-gemm-backend marlin` is set, W4A4 NVFP4 dense linears take the existing weight-only Marlin path on SM100 too, the same way ModelOpt NVFP4 honors the flag. Without the flag, SM100 still uses the native W4A4 scheme.
- The warning now names the reason for each case. For an explicit marlin request it also says that NVFP4 MoE layers follow `--moe-runner-backend` and stay W4A4.
- `test_compressed_tensors_fp4_schemes.py`: a CPU regression test for SM100 + `marlin`. It asserts that the linear gets the weight-only scheme, the MoE keeps `CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE`, and the warning says both. It fails on `main` and passes with this change.

## Accuracy Tests

1x NVIDIA B200 (compute capability 10.0), image `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`, `python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <model> --tp 1 [--fp4-gemm-backend marlin]`, then `python -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 200`.

| Model | Code | `--fp4-gemm-backend` | Result | GSM8K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RedHatAI/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 | main | marlin | crashes (`BackendSupportedError`, below) | n/a |
| RedHatAI/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 | this PR | marlin | serves, dense linears via FP4 Marlin | 0.935 |
| RedHatAI/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 | this PR | auto (native W4A4) | serves, unchanged path | 0.905 |
| RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4 | this PR | marlin | serves, dense via Marlin, MoE stays W4A4 | 0.910 |

The weight-only Marlin result is in line with the native W4A4 path. 200 questions is too small to read anything into the 0.03 difference.

Note: both main and this PR were run on the image's checkout (`684fea8`). For the "this PR" rows, this commit was applied on top as a patch, because the image could not fetch from GitHub. It applies cleanly and touches only `compressed_tensors.py`, so the only difference between the before and after rows is this change.

### Before (main 684fea8, `--fp4-gemm-backend marlin`)

```
  File ".../layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/compressed_tensors.py", line 1324, in apply
    return scheme.apply_weights(layer, x, bias=bias)
  File ".../compressed_tensors/schemes/compressed_tensors_w4a4_nvfp4.py", line 158, in apply_weights
    out = fp4_gemm(
  File ".../layers/quantization/modelopt_quant.py", line 168, in fp4_gemm
    return flashinfer_fp4_gemm(
  File ".../flashinfer/utils.py", line 1553, in wrapper
    raise BackendSupportedError(
flashinfer.utils.BackendSupportedError: mm_fp4 does not support backend 'marlin' with capability 100
```

### After (this PR, `--fp4-gemm-backend marlin`)

Qwen3-8B-NVFP4:
```
--fp4-gemm-backend marlin is weight-only; serving NVFP4 w4a4 dense linears weight-only via FP4 Marlin, so their activation quantization is ignored. MoE layers follow --moe-runner-backend and stay w4a4.
/generate "The capital of France is" -> " Paris. The capital of Germany is Berlin. The capital of Italy is Rome."
Accuracy: 0.935  Invalid: 0.000
```

Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4:
```
--fp4-gemm-backend marlin is weight-only; serving NVFP4 w4a4 dense linears weight-only via FP4 Marlin, so their activation quantization is ignored. MoE layers follow --moe-runner-backend and stay w4a4.
Using CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE
Accuracy: 0.910  Invalid: 0.000
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This only changes which scheme is picked for an explicit `--fp4-gemm-backend marlin`; the default path on SM100 is unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body: @hnyls2002 Following your note on #44091 about picking a single change and verifying it on a real run: this PR is the narrow fix for #43988. It touches only compressed-tensors scheme selection plus a CPU regression test. I verified it on a B200, with before/after logs and GSM8K in the description. It's rebased onto the latest `main` and the title follows the new format. Could someone add `run-ci` when there's a chance? Thanks!
@BBuf thanks for the approval. Could you comment /tag-and-rerun-ci so the CI suite runs on the current commit

@BBuf CI status on 5b08d1bc53

NVIDIA base-b failed twice at dependency install with "No space left on device" on the 5090 vast runners (vast-no-0, vast-cz-0, vast-ok-0), so those shards never ran a test and fail-fast stopped the rest. base-b-test-4-gpu-b200 did run and passed, including test_nvfp4_linear_backends.py and test_nvfp4_moe_backends.py

NPU (pd_disaggregation collects no tests, z_image performance threshold) and AMD (test_kda_kernels Triton register allocation on MI300) failed the same way on both attempts and don't touch compressed-tensors

The numeric check for the scheme this PR now selects on SM100, CompressedTensorsW4A16Fp4 with has_input_global_scale, is in test_compressed_tensors_fp4_numeric.py, which is registered on 4-gpu-b200 but only runs in the kernel-unit stage. Could you run `/rerun-test test/registered/kernels/ops/quantization/test_compressed_tensors_fp4_numeric.py` so it gets B200 coverage. The end-to-end B200 before/after with GSM8K is in the PR description
